newsitem.title: UK: LEP appoints agent in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: LEP appoints agent in Pakistan.

text.p: UK-based global freight forwarder LEP International, part of the LEP Group Plc, has appointed Network Cargo Services (NCS) as its exclusive agents and strategic alliance partner in Pakistan.

Andrew Birtley, LEP's regional manager for South Asia said: "NCS has a unique combination of forwarding and logistics capacilities, and will play a key role in our strategy of providing a full range of quality driven logistics solutions for companies operating in the South Asia region."
Established in 1994, NCS is a fully licenced freight forwarder, headquartered in Karachi, with a staff of 120 located in 12 offices throughout the country.

NCS offers fully containerised express trucking services to over 50 cities and also specialises in heavylift movements for project cargoes to inland destinations. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
